narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>I think only a square has equal diagonals, so the square must be special.
<bookmark mark='rect'/>Every rectangle has two equal diagonals, and a square is one kind of rectangle.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Equal diagonals are not what makes the square special, so we look at the angles.
